observations: Photo 0: Front view of a silver and black scooter. The front headlight is cracked and dirty. The Suzuki logo is visible on the front fairing. The scooter has a single front wheel and a kickstand is down.

Photo 1: Rear view of the scooter. The seat is black and worn. The rear taillight is intact. A Nigerian license plate (FWJ-4870P) is attached. The rear fender is silver. The scooter has a rearview mirror and a small storage box on the back.

Photo 2: Rear view of the scooter from a slightly different angle. The same license plate is visible. The rear taillight is intact. The scooter has a visible exhaust pipe on the right side. The ground is concrete, and a small stone bench is visible to the right.

claims.claim: Fast and reliable scooter available for serious buyers
claims.evidence: Performance and reliability cannot be assessed from photos alone. No video or test ride is provided.
The scooter appears to have some wear and tear (cracked headlight, worn seat, dirt), but no visible mechanical faults are shown. No close-up of engine, brakes, or electrical system is provided.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine or mechanical issues (e.g., oil leaks, worn gears, brake problems)
risks.proof: Close-up of the engine compartment, oil dipstick, and brake system (including brake pads and rotors).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or requiring major repairs.

risks.risk: Electrical system failure (e.g., battery, lights, horn, or ignition issues)
risks.proof: Video of the scooter starting and running, including lights and horn functioning.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly not working or with electrical faults.

risks.risk: Structural damage or frame issues (e.g., bent frame, cracked body panels)
risks.proof: Close-up of the frame, especially near the engine and undercarriage, and the entire body for dents or cracks.

risks.risk: Ownership or title issues (e.g., stolen, not registered, or not legally transferable)
risks.proof: Photo of the vehicle's registration certificate or title, or a video showing the scooter being driven and registered.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially illegal or untransferable.

proof_requests: Video of the scooter starting and running, including lights, horn, and engine sound.
Close-up of the engine compartment, oil dipstick, and brake system.
Close-up of the frame and undercarriage for structural damage.
Photo of the vehicle's registration certificate or title.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
